description: This Java class implements the AdHocWritePlatformService interface, providing methods for creating, updating, deleting, enabling, and disabling ad-hoc query entities within the Fineract platform. It handles data validation, security, and data integrity exceptions, and interacts with the database via JPA repository.

classes.name: AdHocWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of service for managing ad-hoc query entities, including creation, update, deletion, enabling, and disabling, with data validation and exception handling.

methods.name: createAdHocQuery
methods.description: Creates a new ad-hoc query entity after validating input and SQL query, handles data integrity issues.

methods.name: updateAdHocQuery
methods.description: Updates an existing ad-hoc query entity identified by ID, with validation and change tracking.

methods.name: deleteAdHocQuery
methods.description: Deletes an ad-hoc query entity by ID, with exception handling for data integrity issues.

methods.name: disableAdHocQuery
methods.description: Marks an ad-hoc query as active (possibly intended to disable, but sets active to true).

methods.name: enableAdHocQuery
methods.description: Marks an ad-hoc query as inactive (possibly intended to enable, but sets active to false).

methods.name: handleDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Handles specific data integrity violations, such as duplicate names, and logs or throws appropriate exceptions.
